nfl_2026_11_NYJ_LAC.summary: Geno Smith practiced fully Friday and carries no designation, so he starts despite the ankle he hurt against Buffalo. The Jets are without receivers Omar Cooper Jr. and Isaiah Williams. The Chargers rule out LB Daiyan Henley, and Ladd McConkey is questionable with a back injury.

items.text: Joe Milton starts at QB for a second straight week; Jalen Hurts is out for the season.
WR DeVonta Smith (hamstring) is cleared to play after missing every game since Week 6.
LB Jihaad Campbell is available for the first time since Week 7 and expected to start.
LB Zack Baun (back) and WR Dontayvion Wicks ruled out; LB Smael Mondon doubtful.
WRs Michael Pittman Jr. and Roman Wilson are questionable as they work back from injured reserve.
LG Mason McCormick is on injured reserve with a dislocated ankle.

nfl_2026_11_PIT_PHI.summary: Philadelphia (2-7) has lost seven straight and starts Joe Milton again with Jalen Hurts out for the season. DeVonta Smith returns after missing every game since Week 6, and LB Jihaad Campbell is back, but Zack Baun is out. Pittsburgh (6-3) lists receivers Michael Pittman Jr. and Roman Wilson as questionable as they come off IR.
